steps.title: Create a basic HTML structure for text alignment examples
steps.instruction: Create an HTML file with a basic structure containing headings and paragraphs to style with CSS text alignment properties.
steps.hint: Start with the standard HTML5 doctype and include a head section with a title, and a body with some content elements like headings and paragraphs.
steps.analogousExample:
Text Alignment Examples

This paragraph will demonstrate text alignment properties.
steps.expectedOutcome: A complete HTML file with headings and paragraphs ready for CSS styling.
successCriteria: The HTML file includes a doctype, html, head, body, and at least one heading and one paragraph element.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've created the HTML foundation needed to practice CSS text alignment.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure your HTML includes all required elements: doctype, html, head, body, and at least one heading and paragraph.
steps.feedbackWrong: The HTML structure is incomplete. Check that you have all the basic HTML elements and content needed for styling.

steps.title: Add CSS file and link it to HTML
steps.instruction: Create a CSS file named 'styles.css' and link it to your HTML file using a <link> tag in the <head> section.
steps.hint: Add a <link> element with rel='stylesheet' and href='styles.css' inside the <head> tags of your HTML.
steps.analogousExample:
<!-- Linking a CSS file -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
steps.seedCode:
Text Alignment Examples

This is a paragraph for text-align examples.

This is inline content for vertical-align examples.
steps.expectedOutcome: The HTML file will have a proper link to the CSS file, enabling styling.
successCriteria: A <link> tag with rel='stylesheet' and href='styles.css' is added inside the <head> section.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully linked the CSS file to your HTML.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure the <link> tag has both rel='stylesheet' and href='styles.css' attributes.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS file isn't linked correctly. Check that you've added a <link> tag with the proper attributes inside the <head>.

steps.title: Apply text-align: left to a paragraph
steps.instruction: In your CSS file, add a rule that selects the paragraph element and sets its text-align property to 'left'.
steps.hint: Use the element selector 'p' to target the paragraph, then add the property text-align: left; inside the rule.
steps.expectedOutcome: The paragraph text will be aligned to the left edge of its container.
successCriteria: The CSS file contains a rule for the paragraph element with text-align: left;
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully applied left alignment to the paragraph. This demonstrates the default text-align behavior.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you're targeting the paragraph element and setting text-align to 'left'.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule is missing or incorrect. Check that you're using the correct selector and property.

steps.title: Apply text-align: center to a heading
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule for the h1 element to center its text horizontally using text-align: center.
steps.hint: Target the h1 selector and set the text-align property to center.
steps.expectedOutcome: The heading text will be centered horizontally in its container.
successCriteria: The h1 selector has a text-align property set to center.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully centered the heading text using text-align: center.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you're targeting the h1 element and setting text-align to center.
steps.feedbackWrong: The heading text is not centered. Check that you've applied text-align: center to the h1 selector.

steps.title: Apply text-align: right to another paragraph
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule to right-align the text of a paragraph element with the class 'right-align'.
steps.hint: Target the paragraph using its class selector and set the text-align property to 'right'.
steps.expectedOutcome: The paragraph with class 'right-align' will have its text aligned to the right side of its container.
successCriteria: A CSS rule exists that selects .right-align and sets text-align: right.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully right-aligned the paragraph text.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you're targeting the correct class and using the right property value.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule for right-aligning the paragraph is missing or incorrect.

steps.title: Apply text-align: justify to demonstrate full justification
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule for the paragraph with class 'justify-align' to apply text-align: justify.
steps.hint: Use the class selector .justify-align and set the text-align property to justify.
steps.expectedOutcome: The paragraph with class 'justify-align' will have its text evenly spaced across the full width.
successCriteria: A CSS rule for .justify-align with text-align: justify is added.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully applied justified alignment to the paragraph.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you're using the correct class selector and property value.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule for justified alignment is missing or incorrect.

steps.title: Create a table structure for vertical-align practice
steps.instruction: Add a table with two rows and two cells inside the body of your HTML file to create a structure for practicing vertical alignment.
steps.hint: Use the <table>, <tr>, and <td> tags to create a simple 2x2 table.
steps.seedCode:
Text Alignment Examples

This paragraph is aligned to the left.

This paragraph is aligned to the right.

This paragraph has justified text, meaning it stretches to fill the width of its container, creating even edges on both sides.
steps.expectedOutcome: A 2x2 table structure is added to the HTML, ready for applying vertical-align CSS rules in later steps.
successCriteria: The HTML contains a <table> element with two <tr> rows, each containing two <td> cells.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully created a table structure. This will allow us to practice vertical alignment on table cells.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added some table elements, but make sure you have exactly two rows with two cells each. Check that you're using <table>, <tr>, and <td> tags correctly.
steps.feedbackWrong: The table structure isn't complete. Remember to use <table> to wrap the entire table, <tr> for each row, and <td> for each cell. Create a 2x2 table with two rows and two cells per row.

steps.title: Apply vertical-align: top to table cells
steps.instruction: In your CSS file, create a CSS rule that selects table cells (td) and apply vertical-align: top to align their content to the top.
steps.hint: Use the td selector to target all table cells, then set the vertical-align property to 'top'.
steps.expectedOutcome: Table cells will have their content aligned to the top when the table structure is added in the next step.
successCriteria: A CSS rule with the td selector and vertical-align: top is present in the CSS file.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully applied vertical-align: top to table cells. This will align content to the top when the table is added.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close! Make sure you're using the correct selector (td) and property (vertical-align: top).
steps.feedbackWrong: Not quite. You need to create a CSS rule that selects table cells (td) and sets vertical-align to 'top'.

steps.title: Apply vertical-align: middle to table cells
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule to center content vertically in table cells by applying vertical-align: middle to the .middle-align class.
steps.hint: Create a new CSS selector for the .middle-align class and set the vertical-align property to middle.
steps.expectedOutcome: A new CSS rule is created that will vertically center content in any element with the class 'middle-align'.
successCriteria: The .middle-align class selector exists with the property vertical-align: middle.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Great! You've successfully added vertical centering for table cells using vertical-align: middle.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close! Make sure you've added the vertical-align property with the value 'middle' to the .middle-align class.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule for vertical-align: middle wasn't added correctly. Check that you've created the .middle-align selector with the proper property.

steps.title: Apply vertical-align: bottom to table cells
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule for a class named 'bottom-align' that applies vertical-align: bottom to align content to the bottom of table cells.
steps.hint: Create a new CSS class selector and set the vertical-align property to 'bottom'.
steps.expectedOutcome: A new CSS rule .bottom-align { vertical-align: bottom; } is added to the stylesheet.
successCriteria: The CSS file contains a .bottom-align class with vertical-align: bottom property.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Perfect! You've successfully added vertical-align: bottom to align content to the bottom of table cells.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure you've created a .bottom-align class with vertical-align: bottom.
steps.feedbackWrong: The CSS rule is missing or incorrect. Create a .bottom-align class with vertical-align: bottom.
